name: The Washington Post
summary:
The Washington Post is the newspaper at washingtonpost.com. The blackletter nameplate in the tab is the favicon story bookmarks request.

Checked 12 November 2026 against washingtonpost.com. The homepage request ended as timeout, so discovery continued with icon paths. No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.washingtonpost.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 9662 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 48×48.
